subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: A basic way to talk about studying a language.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Estou a aprender português este ano.
exampleSentences.english: I am learning Portuguese this year.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Tenho uma aula amanhã de manhã.
exampleSentences.english: I have a class tomorrow morning.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, em que página estamos?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, what page are we on?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: Very useful with teachers and classmates.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, pode repetir isso?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, can you repeat that?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I do not understand this exercise.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda não percebo este exercício.
exampleSentences.english: I still do not understand this exercise.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: How do you say this in Portuguese?
portuguese: Como é que se diz isto em português?
pronunciationNote: KOH-moo eh k s diz EESH-too eng por-too-GUEZ

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como é que se diz isto em português, afinal?
exampleSentences.english: How do you say this in Portuguese, then?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Can you write it on the board?
notes: Useful when you need to see a word written down.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se faz favor, pode escrever no quadro?
exampleSentences.english: Please, can you write it on the board?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: A simple way to talk about effort.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes do teste, preciso de estudar mais.
exampleSentences.english: Before the test, I need to study more.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje esqueci-me do caderno em casa.
exampleSentences.english: Today I forgot my notebook at home.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para escrever, preciso de uma caneta.
exampleSentences.english: To write, I need a pen.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpa, posso pedir uma caneta emprestada?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, can I borrow a pen?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não posso sair cedo. Tenho trabalhos de casa hoje.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot go out early. I have homework today.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para me organizar, quando é o teste?
exampleSentences.english: To organise myself, when is the test?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am not ready for the test.
portuguese: Não estou preparado para o teste.
pronunciationNote: nown esh-TOH preh-pah-RAH-doo PAH-rah oo TESH-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Acho que ainda não estou preparado para o teste.
exampleSentences.english: I think I am still not ready for the test.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para acabar este exercício, preciso de mais tempo.
exampleSentences.english: To finish this exercise, I need more time.

exampleSentences.portuguese: No fim, podemos ver as respostas?
exampleSentences.english: At the end, can we check the answers?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Aqui cometi um erro.
exampleSentences.english: I made a mistake here.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Can you correct this for me?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tiver tempo, pode corrigir isto para mim?
exampleSentences.english: When you have time, can you correct this for me?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, como se soletra isso?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, how do you spell that?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: Useful in class and outside class.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda estou a aprender. Fale mais devagar, por favor.
exampleSentences.english: I am still learning. Please speak more slowly.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Durante a semana, estudo à noite.
exampleSentences.english: During the week, I study in the evening.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I usually revise at the weekend.
portuguese: Normalmente revejo ao fim de semana.
pronunciationNote: nor-mal-MEN-t rreh-VEH-zhoo ow feeng d seh-MAH-nah
notes: Useful when talking about study routine.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para não esquecer, normalmente revejo ao fim de semana.
exampleSentences.english: So I do not forget, I usually revise at the weekend.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Temos de sair cedo. A aula começa às nove.
exampleSentences.english: We have to leave early. The lesson starts at nine.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: The lesson finishes at half past ten.
portuguese: A aula acaba às dez e meia.
pronunciationNote: ah OW-lah ah-KAH-bah az dezh ee MAY-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Depois podemos tomar café. A aula acaba às dez e meia.
exampleSentences.english: Afterwards we can have coffee. The lesson finishes at half past ten.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to read this text.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para a aula, preciso de ler este texto.
exampleSentences.english: For class, I need to read this text.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to write a short text.
portuguese: Preciso de escrever um texto curto.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d esh-kreh-VAIR oom TESH-too KOOR-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje preciso de escrever um texto curto em português.
exampleSentences.english: Today I need to write a short text in Portuguese.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This word is new to me.
portuguese: Esta palavra é nova para mim.
pronunciationNote: ESH-tah pah-LAHV-rah eh NOH-vah PAH-rah meeng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda não a conhecia. Esta palavra é nova para mim.
exampleSentences.english: I did not know it yet. This word is new to me.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não preciso de a procurar. Já conheço esta palavra.
exampleSentences.english: I do not need to look it up. I already know this word.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para este exercício, posso usar um dicionário?
exampleSentences.english: For this exercise, can I use a dictionary?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to look this word up.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não sei o significado. Preciso de procurar esta palavra.
exampleSentences.english: I do not know the meaning. I need to look this word up.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje estou a praticar a pronúncia em voz alta.
exampleSentences.english: Today I am practising pronunciation out loud.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: Useful when asking for speaking feedback.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Estou a treinar. Pode ouvir-me?
exampleSentences.english: I am practising. Can you listen to me?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
portuguese: Diga isso outra vez, por favor.
pronunciationNote: DEE-gah EE-soo OH-trah vez poor fah-VOR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não ouvi bem. Diga isso outra vez, por favor.
exampleSentences.english: I did not hear properly. Please say it again.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes de continuar, posso fazer uma pergunta?
exampleSentences.english: Before continuing, can I ask a question?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, o que quer dizer isto?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, what does this mean?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I have to hand this in today.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não me posso esquecer. Tenho de entregar isto hoje.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot forget. I have to hand this in today.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para organizar o trabalho, qual é o prazo?
exampleSentences.english: To organise the work, when is the deadline?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to send this by email.
portuguese: Preciso de enviar isto por email.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d en-vee-AR EESH-too poor ee-MAIL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Depois de acabar, preciso de enviar isto por email.
exampleSentences.english: After finishing, I need to send this by email.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ontem faltei à aula porque estava doente.
exampleSentences.english: Yesterday I missed class because I was ill.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como faltei, tens os apontamentos?
exampleSentences.english: Since I missed it, do you have the notes?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Can you send me the notes?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se não te importas, podes enviar-me os apontamentos?
exampleSentences.english: If you do not mind, can you send me the notes?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I want to improve my listening.
portuguese: Quero melhorar a minha compreensão oral.
pronunciationNote: KEH-roo meh-lyoh-RAR ah MEE-nyah kom-preh-en-SOWN oh-RAL
notes: Useful for talking about study aims.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Este mês quero melhorar a minha compreensão oral.
exampleSentences.english: This month I want to improve my listening.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I want to speak more confidently.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Com prática, quero falar com mais confiança.
exampleSentences.english: With practice, I want to speak more confidently.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to practise every day.
portuguese: Preciso de praticar todos os dias.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d prah-tee-KAR TOH-dooz ooz DEE-ash

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se quiser melhorar, preciso de praticar todos os dias.
exampleSentences.english: If I want to improve, I need to practise every day.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, este exercício é fácil.
exampleSentences.english: For me, this exercise is easy.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje este exercício é difícil para mim.
exampleSentences.english: Today this exercise is difficult for me.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para perceber melhor, preciso de um exemplo.
exampleSentences.english: To understand better, I need an example.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda não percebo bem. Pode dar outro exemplo?
exampleSentences.english: I still do not quite understand. Can you give another example?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
notes: Useful for talking positively about learning.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Devagar, mas estou a fazer progressos.
exampleSentences.english: Slowly, but I am making progress.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I still have a lot to learn.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Já melhorei, mas ainda tenho muito para aprender.
exampleSentences.english: I have already improved, but I still have a lot to learn.
